title: gammaloop
description: GammaLoop computes differential collider cross-sections using Local Unitarity. Each versioned record preserves the source artifacts available for that release. Modern releases comprise gammalooprs, gammaloop-api, and the GammaLoop Python source distribution; historical layouts and artifact sets may differ.
notes: GammaLoop-authored source is available under the MIT License. Modern official GammaLoop Python distributions, normal Cargo builds from the repository root, and the default Nix package activate Symbolica under GammaLoop's OEM license. Consumers compiling modern gammalooprs or gammaloop-api releases from crates.io must set the public compile-time selector SYMBOLICA_OEM_LICENSE=SYMBOLICA_OEM_GAMMALOOP; it is not a personal license or secret. Historical versions preserve their original Symbolica integration and activation behavior; consult the archived source for that version. Symbolica and other third-party software remain governed by their own terms.
